title: SCITT_ContinuityReceipt_v00
description: IETF draft-nikolaichuk-scitt-continuity-receipts-00 state recovery continuity proof schema. Enforces verifiable state preservation across distributed multi-cluster migrations and process restarts.

state_recovery_root.description: SHA-256 Merkle root of the durable checkpoint state.

prev_continuation_hash.description: Continuation hash from the preceding epoch.

continuation_hash.description: Current continuation hash: SHA256(prev_continuation_hash || state_recovery_root || epoch_index).

checkpoint_authority.description: Identifier of the cluster coordinator or enclave asserting the checkpoint.

migration_cluster_id.description: Optional destination cluster identifier during cross-cloud migration.

tree_size.description: Size of the SCITT transparency tree at checkpoint.

leaf_index.description: Index of this checkpoint leaf in the transparency tree.

inclusion_proof.description: RFC 9162 audit path proving leaf inclusion in the tree root.

timestamp_utc.description: UTC timestamp of the checkpoint assertion.
